# HRVT — SaaS Motion Design

> HRVT is a one-person motion design studio (Ádám, based in Hungary, working remotely worldwide) that makes high-end product videos for SaaS companies: 30–60 second product explainers, feature and UI animation videos, launch and announcement videos, and social/ad cutdowns.

## Services
- 30–60s Product Explainer Videos
- Feature & UI Animation Videos
- Launch & Announcement Videos
- Social & Ad Cutdowns (from the main video)

## Who it is for
Early-stage and growth-stage SaaS companies, founders and marketing teams whose product is powerful but hard to explain in plain screenshots: complex workflows, AI features, dashboards, multi-step processes.

## Pricing (USD)
- 30-second Feature / Explainer Video: starting from $2,800
- 60-second Product Story Video: starting from $5,500
- Social Cutdown Pack (3–5 shorter versions): from $900
Final price depends on complexity, number of scenes and revision rounds. Every project starts with a clear fixed quote.

## Process
1. Discovery call — product, goals, key messages
2. Concept & script direction — structure and visual approach
3. Design & animation — full motion design with regular check-ins
4. Delivery — final video, social cutdowns, source files if needed
Typical turnaround: 10–18 days depending on complexity.

## Selected work
- Orlo — 30s scheduling product video: https://hrvt.vercel.app/motion/orlo.mp4
- Mirra — 30s AI support inbox explainer: https://hrvt.vercel.app/motion/mirra.mp4
- Halden — 30s runway forecasting product video: https://hrvt.vercel.app/motion/halden.mp4

## FAQ
- Do you write the script? I can help refine the message and structure. Most clients come with core points, and we shape it together.
- Can you match our existing brand? Yes. I adapt to your visual identity, colors, and tone.
- What do I need to provide? Product access or recordings, key benefits, brand guidelines (if you have them), and any existing assets.
- Do you offer revisions? Yes. Every package includes structured revision rounds.
- Can you also do shorter social versions? Yes, most clients order a main video + cutdowns for LinkedIn, X, and ads.
